description: React component for a user group header submenu with actions like edit, join, leave, and archive group, including permission checks and modal interactions.

methods.name: goToEditGroupModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to edit user group details and triggers onExited callback.

methods.name: leaveGroup
methods.description: Removes current user from group and decrements member count.

methods.name: joinGroup
methods.description: Adds current user to group and increments member count.

methods.name: archiveGroup
methods.description: Archives the group, then calls backButtonCallback and onExited.
